record.source_closeout_reference: Authored during the mission in the Claude Code session executing the sponsor-approved four-mission strengthening plan; commit hash to be recorded at commit time

mission.objective: Create the research-only mutable-harness-state principle naming model identity, skill state, and credential state as state that replay evidence must pin or record; add advisory model-identity recording guidance and an optional model_routing template field to the mission-record design; retire the Phase 3 acceptability of missing model identity for new records; register the lane as V3-ANCHOR-008.

envelope.reference: Sponsor instruction in the Claude Code conversation approving execution of steps 1-4 of the strengthening plan, with step 1 covering mutable harness state and model identity
envelope.not_created_reason: Bounded docs-only change executed from a direct thread-local sponsor instruction; this shadow record was authored during the mission.

forbidden_scope: no required record fields or enforcement
no invalidation of existing mission records or pilot evidence
allowed_commands: scoped git add, commit, and push after approval
fallback_triggers: scope expands beyond the named docs and template
any wording implies required fields, enforcement, promotion, routing, or runtime authority
an external vendor claim is presented as local Factory evidence
verification reports an unresolved advisory finding

verification.summary: Advisory lint, readiness eval, NL pilot, knowledge lint, and diff whitespace checks passed on the first run after the edits; mission-record lint run after this record was authored to confirm the optional model_routing field is accepted by the advisory schema route.

notes: Docs-and-template-only change with no new dependencies, validators, or code paths.
All new guidance is advisory; existing records and pilot evidence stay valid with gaps explicit rather than retroactively invalidated.
External vendor signals (model routing, vaults, skill systems) are labeled announcement-grade and explicitly excluded from counting as local Factory evidence.
Scope stayed inside the named principle doc, design doc, template, Phase 3 note, registry row, and README scope bullet.
No required fields, enforcement, promotion, routing, credential-use, or runtime scope was added.

friction_notes: The optional model_routing template object has no advisory validator support yet; until the named follow-up lands, the field is recorded but unchecked.

Vendor routing means the model field may need to hold a set rather than a single value for routed harnesses; the template models this with observed_models but no local routed-harness evidence exists to test the shape.
false_positive_notes: No advisory findings were raised on this change.
false_negative_notes: No false negatives observed after the advisory pass; absence of validator coverage for model_routing is named as a follow-up rather than treated as a pass.

phase2_design_signals: Pinning-or-recording mutable harness state is a single principle that covers model identity, skill versions, and credential references; naming it once avoided three disconnected field debates.
Retiring an earlier acceptability note by versioned change-log entry preserves the historical record while changing forward guidance, and is cheaper than schema migration.
The model_routing shape should be validated against a real routed-harness mission before any validator work hardens it.
